findings.evidence: `nl -ba .../Isotopy.lean` shows lines 34-35: “knot invariants must be built on ... `AmbientIsotopic` ... never on `Isotopy`/`Isotopic`,” while lines 45-46 still say `Isotopic` is the relation downstream knot-equivalence layers traffic in.
findings.fix: Rewrite this bullet, and preferably the earlier lines 20-22, to state that `Isotopic` is the general non-ambient relation and that knot-equivalence layers should use `AmbientIsotopic` from `TauCeti.Topology.Homotopy.AmbientIsotopic`.
findings.issue: The module doc still says `TauCeti.Isotopic f₀ f₁` is “the reusable relation downstream knot-equivalence ... layers traffic in,” contradicting the new warning at lines 34-35 and 375-377 that knot invariants must use `AmbientIsotopic`, not `Isotopic`.

summary: The added warning correctly changes the intended public guidance, but the same module doc still advertises `Isotopic` as the downstream knot-equivalence relation. That leaves the public interface documentation contradictory and risks users building knot APIs on the degenerate relation the PR is trying to rule out.
